info.brief: Callback-based browser clipboard and file I/O for Defold. Browser operations are available on HTML5 builds; capability functions report support in the current browser.
info.description: Callback-based browser clipboard and file I/O for Defold. Browser operations are available on HTML5 builds; capability functions report support in the current browser.

elements.name: browser_io.is_supported
elements.description: Returns true when the extension is running on an HTML5 build. This is a platform check; use can_* functions for individual browser capabilities.

returnvalues.name: supported
returnvalues.doc: True on HTML5, false on other platforms.

elements.name: browser_io.can_copy
elements.description: Returns true when clipboard text writing is available in the current browser context.

returnvalues.name: supported
returnvalues.doc: True when browser_io.copy can be attempted.

elements.name: browser_io.can_paste
elements.description: Returns true when clipboard text reading is available in the current browser context. Browser permission or user-gesture rules can still reject an individual request.

returnvalues.name: supported
returnvalues.doc: True when browser_io.paste can be attempted.

elements.name: browser_io.can_open_file
elements.description: Returns true when the browser exposes the APIs required to open and read a file.

returnvalues.name: supported
returnvalues.doc: True when browser_io.open_file can be attempted.

elements.name: browser_io.can_save_file
elements.description: Returns true when the browser exposes the APIs required to create a downloadable file.

returnvalues.name: supported
returnvalues.doc: True when browser_io.save_file can be attempted.

elements.name: browser_io.can_drop_files
elements.description: Returns true when the browser exposes drag-and-drop and file-reading APIs. This does not guarantee that external file dropping is practical on touch-only devices.

returnvalues.name: supported
returnvalues.doc: True when drag-and-drop APIs are available.

elements.name: browser_io.copy
elements.description: Copies UTF-8 text to the browser clipboard asynchronously. Call from a direct user interaction where required by the browser.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.doc: Called as callback(self, result). result contains success, cancelled, operation, and error when applicable.

elements.name: browser_io.paste
elements.description: Reads UTF-8 text from the browser clipboard asynchronously. Call from a direct user interaction where required by the browser.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.doc: Called as callback(self, result). On success result.data contains the clipboard text and result.size contains its byte length.

elements.name: browser_io.open_file
elements.description: Opens the browser file picker and asynchronously reads one file. Supported forms are open_file(callback), open_file(nil, callback), and open_file(options, callback).

parameters.name: callback
parameters.doc: Called as callback(self, result). On success result.name, result.data, and result.size are set. Empty files return data as an empty string and size as 0.

elements.name: browser_io.open_file
elements.description: Opens the browser file picker and asynchronously reads one file. Supported forms are open_file(callback), open_file(nil, callback), and open_file(options, callback).

parameters.name: options
parameters.doc: Optional table. accept is an HTML accept string and max_size is the maximum file size in bytes. The default max_size is 16 MiB.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.doc: Called as callback(self, result). On success result.name, result.data, and result.size are set. Empty files return data as an empty string and size as 0.

elements.name: browser_io.save_file
elements.description: Creates a browser download from a Lua string. Binary strings are supported. Supported forms are save_file(filename, data, callback), save_file(filename, data, nil, callback), and save_file(filename, data, options, callback).

parameters.name: callback
parameters.doc: Called as callback(self, result) when the download has been handed to the browser.

elements.name: browser_io.save_file
elements.description: Creates a browser download from a Lua string. Binary strings are supported. Supported forms are save_file(filename, data, callback), save_file(filename, data, nil, callback), and save_file(filename, data, options, callback).

parameters.name: options
parameters.doc: Optional table. mime_type defaults to application/octet-stream.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.doc: Called as callback(self, result) when the download has been handed to the browser.

elements.name: browser_io.set_drop_listener
elements.description: Registers a persistent file drag-and-drop listener on the browser window. Supported forms are set_drop_listener(callback), set_drop_listener(nil, callback), and set_drop_listener(options, callback).

parameters.name: callback
parameters.doc: Called for each completed drop as callback(self, result). On success result.name, result.data, and result.size are set.

returnvalues.name: enabled
returnvalues.doc: True when the listener was enabled on HTML5, false on unsupported build targets.

elements.name: browser_io.set_drop_listener
elements.description: Registers a persistent file drag-and-drop listener on the browser window. Supported forms are set_drop_listener(callback), set_drop_listener(nil, callback), and set_drop_listener(options, callback).

parameters.name: options
parameters.doc: Optional table. accept filters dropped files and max_size limits the number of bytes read. The default max_size is 16 MiB.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.doc: Called for each completed drop as callback(self, result). On success result.name, result.data, and result.size are set.

returnvalues.name: enabled
returnvalues.doc: True when the listener was enabled on HTML5, false on unsupported build targets.

elements.name: browser_io.cancel_drop_listener
elements.description: Removes the persistent drag-and-drop listener and releases its Lua callback.
